0.name: TEXT_FESNYRFSTSHOGUN2014_00145_YELLOWGENERAL_000_000
0.description: Why does she speak that way, you ask? An astute question, at last. The uma bugyo is a lady of a house most noble, and it is the high speech of the Far East that you note with pleasing keenness.

1.name: TEXT_FESNYRFSTSHOGUN2014_00145_YELLOWGENERAL_000_001
1.description: She is high-minded as well as gently spoken, and this labor is one that she freely undertook over considerable...skepticism in some circles.

2.name: TEXT_FESNYRFSTSHOGUN2014_00145_YELLOWGENERAL_000_010
2.description: Your head is bare, adventurer. Do I have another uma kabuto, you ask? There was meant to be but one, a proof of <hex:020817E905FF096D276C6164792773FF096D276C6F7264277303> success in Gridania.

3.name: TEXT_FESNYRFSTSHOGUN2014_00145_YELLOWGENERAL_000_011
3.description: How vexing. I have no choice but to grant you another, but...how vexing.
